name: HTML table layout
summary: Using nested HTML tables, with clear 1px spacer images, to place boxes on a page.
how: Set a table of 760px to 800px and centre it.
Nest tables for each column and each box, with 2px spacing and 4px padding.
Use a 1px clear GIF to hold the width of a cell.
Split the page into a header row, a link column and a content column.

origin.note: Netscape Navigator 1.1 added table support, and designers used tables for page layout.

adoptions.via: Web portals place search, links, news and ads in dense table grids.
